invtes.reason: 'Cone-shaped' and 'like a screw thread' made a solid object: every seed is a tall smooth cone with a hard brass-like lower half and a violet stripe winding up it, a party hat or an incense cone. Beside the other three essences (invbet, invceh, invfed: low broad heaps of loose powder) it is not dust at 1x or 2x.

fix.desc: An essence: a small low heap of fine dark violet dust, wider than it is tall, its loose grains slumping at the edges, the same kind of heap as the other essences, faint violet glints scattered over it, and rising from its peak a thin wisp of pale violet vapour twisted round itself into a tight corkscrew.
fix.note: the heap words of invbet, invceh and invfed; no cone and no groove (they made a solid cone): the twist is only in the vapour, and where it doesn't come out the violet alone sets it apart, as invceh's colour does; prefer a seed whose wisp stays joined to the heap (invbet s101's came off as a stray piece)
fix.seeds: a new run with the 8 seeds of round 2 (--seeds 101,202,303,404,505,606,707,808): the changed words make new jobs
